content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"Operational Enhancements is a program run by U.S. Special Operations Command (SOCOM), funded through the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Defense-Wide account.","citation":{"fact_id":"78bafa309f950340"}},{"text":"The program's public budget documents provide little detail — the official narrative states only that 'Details are provided under separate cover,' meaning the specifics are classified.","citation":{"fact_id":"424ec39378513a95"}},{"text":"The program is tracked internally under project number S500A, also titled 'Operational Enhancements.'","citation":{"fact_id":"53270d6fa6d7d8a3"}},{"text":"Cumulative funding across all prior years for the program totals about $2,198.964 million (roughly $2.2 billion).","citation":{"fact_id":"53270d6fa6d7d8a3"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"In fiscal year 2024, the program recorded actual spending of $225,746 thousand (about $225.7 million).","citation":{"fact_id":"424ec39378513a95"}},{"text":"For fiscal year 2025, the program was enacted at $255,507 thousand (about $255.5 million).","citation":{"fact_id":"8c434966e6e8939f"}},{"text":"The fiscal year 2026 total request rises to $269,403 thousand (about $269.4 million).","citation":{"fact_id":"0de7d2ae6820199b"}},{"text":"That is an increase of $13,896 thousand from fiscal year 2025 to 2026, a rise of about 5.44 percent.","citation":{"fact_id":"749351969ccd99f6"}},{"text":"The fiscal year 2026 total is made up of a discretionary request of $234,653 thousand plus a reconciliation request of $34,750 thousand.","citation":{"fact_id":"c469703f38c97c5a"}},{"text":"The reconciliation portion of the fiscal year 2026 request adds $34,750 thousand (about $34.8 million) on top of the discretionary base.","citation":{"fact_id":"95d0990beaaf19f6"}}]},"players":{"claims":[{"text":"The program is administered by U.S. Special Operations Command (SOCOM).","citation":{"fact_id":"9d40bbc63f4031ec"}},{"text":"Lobbying filings from the Boeing Company in 2024 referenced 'enhancements,' along with corporate and aviation industry tax issues and research and development audit procedures.","citation":{"fact_id":"005fc74423472220"}},{"text":"A 2024 Boeing filing referencing the matched term also mentioned H.R.7024, the Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act of 2024.","citation":{"fact_id":"005c113d6816ce7e"}},{"text":"A 2025 Boeing filing referenced the Concurrent Resolution on the Budget for Fiscal Year 2025 (H.Con.Res.14 and S.Con.Res.7).","citation":{"fact_id":"00d2d23443bc20fb"}},{"text":"A 2025 Boeing filing referenced H.R.1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.","citation":{"fact_id":"0077bf7d5c9015ca"}},{"text":"A 2026 Boeing filing referenced H.R.1062, the Growing and Preserving Innovation in America Act of 2025, and S.1605.","citation":{"fact_id":"01bfec7dbc6c2604"}}]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[]}}
